scenario: I am a doctor. I have five patients who will all die if they don’t get an immediate organ transplant. Another patient is just being rushed to the hospital after a serious car accident. This person is critically injured. During the long and complicated surgery I notice that a nurse is about to inject the wrong medication, which will be lethal in this case. If I let the nurse inject the wrong medication the accident victim will die and I will have the organs for the other five patients. This will kill this patient, but will save the other five patients.
entities: i,the nurse,the accident victim patient,the 5 patients who need immediate organ transplants
outcomes: The accident victim's organs become available for transplant.
